scope: Follow-up DOI lookup for three already verified scientific works. Null means no DOI confirmed in consulted sources, not proof that no DOI exists.

resnick.primaryPageResult: Author/title/1994 hardcover and 1997 paperback confirmed; no DOI displayed.
resnick.searchResult: Returned same-title review records and other works. These review DOIs were rejected as identifiers of the book.
resnick.outcome: Candidate not verified; retain DOI null and stable publisher URL.

hinton.primaryPageResult: Publisher abstract and author-maintained university bibliography confirm original 1987 Complex Systems paper without a DOI.
hinton.searchResult: No exact original-paper DOI found; a 2025 commentary DOI is a different work and was rejected.
hinton.outcome: Retain DOI null; original publisher URL is canonical.

swarm.primaryPageResult: Official project documentation recommends the 1996 Santa Fe Institute Working Paper 96-06-042 with four authors and no DOI.
swarm.institutionalPageResult: Previously downloaded institutional abstract retained; current web.open rendering exposes generic Working Papers shell.
swarm.searchResult: No exact report DOI found; later toolkit and modeling works are different publications and were rejected.
swarm.outcome: Retain DOI null and stable institutional URL.
